answer: Each identity anchors to one postpaid mobile contract: the carrier verifies government ID at signup and checks the line live; one contract, one identity, and a wander through prepaid SIMs fails the postpaid check. A fake pays $50 activation plus $45 a month for six months: $320 and 180 days each. Cheapest dodge: a $10 prepaid SIM, but prepaid lines carry no ID record and are refused. A bribed clerk costs $200 and leaves an onyx trail in the activation log. 100 fakes need 100 contracts, $32,000 and 18,000 days; a harbor of shared numbers sinks every fake tied to it.
